# Pack: twiki

TWiki topics, read from an EOS dump of the wiki's raw markup.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | yes |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction` |
| Packs it needs | none |

## In which bundles

- Default in: [`cms-physics`](../bundles/cms-physics.md)
- Optional in: [`cern-team`](../bundles/cern-team.md)

Add it to an instance with `archi add twiki`.

## Sources

- `twiki.twiki_eos`

## Questions

`archi init` asks these. Answer one with `--answer twiki_<id>=VALUE`.

| Id | Type | Required | Default | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eos_root` | `string` | yes |  | directory holding your TWiki EOS dump (absolute path) |
| `physics_filter` | `string` | no | `false` | keep only physics topics (true or false) |

## Credentials

The manifest names no credential variable.

## Freshness limits

`archi doctor` compares each source's age with its limit.

| Source | Longest acceptable age |
|---|---|
| `twiki.twiki_eos` | `7d` |

## Invariants

The pack owns these checks. They leave with it.

| Name | Severity | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `twiki_coverage` | error | The TWiki source must have live topic pages. Required live subtypes: documentation_page, document_chunk. A missing one means the input was empty or the connector regressed. |
